question.text: Which one of the following is not a property of physical adsorption?

options.text: Higher the pressure, more the adsorption
Greater the surface area, more the adsorption
Lower the temperature, more the adsorption

solution.text: Physical adsorption increases with an increase in pressure. It also increases with the surface area. As adsorption is exothermic process so as temperature decreases, adsorption increases. It is a multilayer adsorption.
